p: Raajesh Homeo Home, Banipark, Jaipur, run by Dr. Rama Mathur, decides how the details you send are used.

When you request an appointment we collect the patient's name, your phone number, the day and time you chose and the kind of visit you picked from a short list. If you book for a child or another person, we also ask for the name of the parent, guardian or person booking, and for your confirmation that you may book for them. We use these only to contact you about that appointment.
If you ask for a call back, we collect your name, phone number and the time of day you prefer.
We also note, in general terms, how you found the site (for example Instagram, Google or a printed QR code). This is not tied to your name and holds no health information.
Please do not put detailed medical information in any form. A request is not a confirmed appointment until the clinic contacts you.
Each form has a consent box that you must tick yourself. You can withdraw consent at any time by emailing the clinic.

You can ask to see, correct or delete the details you sent. Email the clinic from the address below and give the phone number you used. You can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

If you accept, we use Google Analytics to count visits and button clicks such as Call and WhatsApp. We never send names, phone numbers, reasons for a visit or any health details to analytics. If you decline, analytics stays off.
Homeopathic care does not replace emergency or specialist medical treatment. In an emergency, go to the nearest hospital or call 112.
Information on this website is general and is not medical advice for your individual situation. No result is promised or implied; people respond differently.
